decision.instructions: Is this Bitcoin address involved in illicit activity?

label_meanings.yes: illicit: the address is involved in illicit activity
label_meanings.no: licit: the address is not involved in illicit activity

input.description: The transaction history of one Elliptic++ bitcoin address up to its time step: the OneJev txhist state as 01_build_data.sh builds it, kept as built. An object with three top-level keys: entity (what the object describes), summary (an overview of the history) and transactions (the address's transactions).

sources.about: 01_build_data.sh 写的 Elliptic++ 地址级 OneJev txhist 行：train.jsonl（时间步 1–29）、val.jsonl（30–34）、test.jsonl（35–49）；val_sub4000.jsonl 不用

rows.about: 一行一个（地址，时间步）：train、val、test.jsonl 的每一行写成一行，id 沿用上游的（addr_<时间步>_<地址>）；state 原样（OneJev txhist：entity、summary、transactions）；question 用任务的问题；target 原样（yes 是 illicit），上游 meta.y 只用来核对它；meta.state_id 是地址；时间步写进 meta.extra.step（上游 meta.step，没有时从 id 取）；上游 meta 的 y、post43、seen_in_train 不写出；label_source 是 human，n_obs 是 1
